profile_text.body:
Pony AI Inc. describes itself as a global autonomous driving technology company founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley. Its website says it is developing autonomous driving systems and operates three business units: Robotaxi, Robotruck, and Personally Owned Vehicles (POV). The company states that its autonomous vehicles have traveled over 32 million kilometers (over 13 million miles) on urban roads and highways as of April 2024, and that it has secured licenses and credentials to test and operate autonomous vehicles in multiple locations.

The company describes its core technology as a "virtual driver" and says it is positioned at the forefront of autonomous driving across Robotaxi, Robotruck, and POV. It states that it is an industry leader in the commercialization of autonomous driving and is committed to developing safe autonomous driving capabilities on a global scale.

Pony AI Inc. is registered with the SEC as a for-profit public company under Central Index Key 0001969302, with headquarters listed in Guangzhou, and it trades under the ticker PONY.
